thread:
sanjay: Heads up — seeing recurring perf drops on rack7 GPU pool since ~02:15 UTC, p99 tokens double and some jobs report OOM+timeouts. Suspect NVLink/AER noise on node gpu-rack7-39.

alex: do you have dmesg / nvidia logs? can you paste the last 200 lines? :eyes:

ops-bot: ALERT: gpu-rack7-39 — NVLINK_LINK_DOWN (3 events in 5m) · AER_CORRECTED (2) · Xid_31_count:+1

sanjay: pasted excerpt below — this aligns with the spike times:
```
[ 38712.452345] nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: AER: corrected error, not a serious issue
[ 38712.452356] nvlink0: link 0 status: lane_err, lane 2 flapping
[ 38712.452789] NVRM: Xid (31) 0x00000000 0x00000001 0x00000002
[ 38713.123456] nvlink0: lane 2 down, training failed, retrying
[ 38715.998231] kernel: pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Multiple correctable errors
```

jamie: ok that's consistent with intermittent physical link flaps — looks like lane stability issue on NVLink. Might be a midplane connector or a flaky card.

maria: any ECC counters incrementing? could be heat or power.

sanjay: ECC counters are low, no big ECC spikes. This is mainly AER corrected + Xid 31 around the same windows.

alex: quick repro plan: schedule a controlled drain of gpu-rack7-39, run 8h stress (cuda-bandwidth-test + nvlink stress), collect nvlink logs and AER counters, swap card if we can reproduce.

leo: +1 for drain. If it's link-level flapping, swapping GPU to another slot (or another board in same host) often isolates whether cable/slot vs GPU.

ops-bot: TASK_CREATED: infra/drain/gpu-rack7-39 assigned to @jamie — due in 30m

jamie: I'll run the drain and set node to maintenance. Proposed steps:
1) cordon node and drain all k8s pods (grace 60s)
2) move live jobs to warm pool, reduce scheduling on rack7 temporarily
3) run: `nvidia-smi nvlink --status` and `dmesg -T | tail -n 200 > /var/tmp/gpu-rack7-39-dmesg.log`
4) run `cuda-bandwidth-test --nvlink 5000` (30m) and `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` for counters
5) if nvlink lane flapping persists, power-cycle host, re-seat GPU in slot A, retest
6) if still unstable, replace GPU with spare from rack7-spares and open RMA with vendor.

alex: add: enable `pci_aer_flags=1` logging and collect `cat /sys/module/pcie_aspm/parameters/policy` and `lspci -vvv -s 3b:00.0` output. capture `setpci -s 3b:00.0 0x...` if needed.

maria: note — replacing card will require a brief capacity hit (1 GPU out). Let's shift some Dedicated capacity to eu-west to keep SLAs; cost tradeoff estimated ~0.2% monthly burst.

sanjay: agreed. Prioritize stability over the small cost delta. Jamie, when you start drain, ping #eng-runtime so we can pause heavy batch jobs.

jamie: starting drain in 25m. leaving a short checklist here:
- notify customers with running long batch jobs on rack7 (dm to owners)
- snapshot node metrics (prometheus scrape)
- collect nvlink serials and firmware versions: `nvidia-smi -q | grep -i nvlink -A5`

leo: if we see Xid 79 or persistent Xid 148, escalate to hw-eng and open a high-priority RMA — those often indicate DMA/fatal errors not recovered by AER.

sanjay: one more thing — we've seen intermittent flaps correlate with firmware mismatches across the NVSwitch on similar boards. capture `nvlink_fw_version` from `nvidia-smi -q`.

ops-bot: UPDATE: maintenance window created 2026-03-18T03:00Z for gpu-rack7-39 — 45m planned.

jamie: drain started. I'll post logs back in this thread and attach the dmesg + nvidia-smi dumps after tests. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — after logs come back I'll run the automated comparator against past incidents to see if this maps to the same failure fingerprint.

sanjay: thanks team. If drain reproduces the issue on re-seat -> vendor RMA. If not, we'll consider midplane/cable inspection.

maria: noted — I'll update capacity routing to avoid affected rack for next 24h and file a charge event for the spare usage.

jamie: posting initial post-drain snippet (03:27Z):
```
/var/tmp/gpu-rack7-39-dmesg.log tail:
[ 39245.223111] nvlink0: lane 2 retrain failed
[ 39245.223455] nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: NVRM: Xid (31) 0x00000004 0x00000012
[ 39246.100987] kernel: AER: Device reported uncorrected error, severity=corrected
```

jamie: ran re-seat test — moved GPU from slot A to B in same host; after re-seat nvlink stabilized for ~12m then flapped again. Escalating to swap with spare.

sanjay: good data point — sounds like card-level fault. Please tag RMA with the Xid logs and nvlink fw/version.

ops-bot: RMA_TICKET_CREATED: ticket# RMA-2026-457 assigned to @infra-support — attached logs.

alex: once replacement installed, let's run the 8h nvlink stress and then a 24h production soak with low ramp to confirm. Also add a watch on AER corrected error rate.

maria: I'll track cost impact and approve spare usage.

sanjay: closing loop: primary owner = jamie, fallback = alex, notify on next AER event.

jamie: will update thread with final status after swap and 24h soak.

leo: thanks all. :rocket:
